description.en: Thin connected tubes form a regular hexagonal mesh below sediment.
description.zh: 纤细相连管道在沉积层下组成规则六角网。

scientific_scope.en: Stylized trace-morphology concept. The ichnogenus names the trace, not its producer; sediment surfaces and cross-sections are illustrative. Listed periods refer to source examples, not the complete range.
scientific_scope.zh: 风格化遗迹形态概念。遗迹属名不等于造迹生物；沉积表面与剖面为示意。所列时期仅对应来源实例，并非完整分布范围。

distinctness.en: Thin connected tubes form a regular hexagonal mesh below sediment.
distinctness.zh: 纤细相连管道在沉积层下组成规则六角网。

modeling_brief.en: Use original low-poly facets to emphasize: thin connected tubes form a regular hexagonal mesh below sediment. Keep secondary texture subordinate to the diagnostic geometry; choose one composition, not counted variants. Display convention: raised-fossil-relief; section cuts are illustrative, not an excavated specimen claim.
modeling_brief.zh: 采用原创低多边形几何突出：纤细相连管道在沉积层下组成规则六角网。次要纹理服从识别结构；只计一种构图，不靠变体增数。 表现方式：凸起化石浮雕；剖切是示意，不声称复制出土标本。

uncertainty: Tracemaker, behavior and relief polarity can be uncertain; never assign a producer species from this concept. The maker remains unresolved; avoid a definitive organism or farming interpretation.
reference_notes: The period list is evidence-scoped, not an exhaustive stratigraphic range. Scale and complexity are art-planning classes only.
production_notes: Planned only. No model, polygon count, measured dimensions or export is supplied. Preserve a visibly distinct silhouette/cross-section at intended viewing distance.

sources.title: Paleodictyon on the Deep-Sea Floor
sources.supports: Hexagonal tunnel network and shafts; identity of maker unresolved
